final_answer: **T-4 bearing seal failure**, caused by corrosion of the bearing seal housing that let seawater into the nacelle, was the only multi-week outage. The pilot **delivered 18.7 GWh** (6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast). **Final cost was EUR 41.25M against a EUR 36.7M budget**, an overrun of EUR 4.55M (12.4%), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign. Independent fish monitoring found **no statistically significant change** in migration counts post-installation (p = 0.41). Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti **recommended replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel** on all remaining nacelles, which the steering group accepted in principle. The steering group **approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026**, contingent on a completed bearing-seal redesign and successful dry-dock endurance test.
